latest.title: AWS IAM: The Key to Secure Cloud Access
latest.description: A practical introduction to AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM), covering users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and security best practices. This article shares my hands-on learning with AWS CLI and Bash automation, including real-world examples of managing access securely in AWS.

latest.title: AWS S3 — Hands-On Security & Storage Practice
latest.description: Hands-on practice with Amazon S3 covering storage, security, versioning, lifecycle management, automation, and cross-region replication.

latest.title: Weekend Deployment Challenge: PromptForge
latest.description:
PromptForge is an AI-powered prompt optimization tool that transforms rough ideas into clear, structured, and effective prompts for AI assistants.

Instead of spending time figuring out how to phrase a prompt, users enter a simple idea, select a desired goal and detail level, and PromptForge generates an improved, copy-ready prompt using Amazon Nova Lite through Amazon Bedrock.

latest.title: "Connection Timed Out" on EC2: How to Diagnose It Properly (and What AWS Connect Assist Does That You Can't)
latest.description: "Connection timed out" tells you nothing about what's actually wrong. Here's the eight-link chain every EC2 connection depends on, what AWS Connect Assist adds on top of it, what it costs per second, and the one category of break that no tool can ever fix.

latest.title: AWS Regions et Availability Zones : comprendre la haute disponibilité
latest.description: Une explication simple des Regions, Availability Zones et choix de localisation pour concevoir des applications AWS plus résilientes.

latest.title: IAM sur AWS : appliquer le principe du moindre privilège

latest.title: Amazon S3 ou Amazon EBS : comprendre la différence
latest.description: Une comparaison simple entre le stockage objet Amazon S3 et le stockage en blocs Amazon EBS, avec des exemples utiles pour débuter sur AWS.

latest.title: Building a Simple Application Architecture with EC2, VPC, RDS, and Docker on AWS
latest.description: Understanding individual AWS services is only the beginning. In this article, I explore how EC2, VPC, RDS, and Docker can work together to create a simple and practical architecture for running a backend application in the AWS Cloud.
